tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ro snyoms phyag rgya chen por sgang dril ba rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i gsung bzhugs so/ /

na mo gu ru/ chos nyid gdod nas dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ / mkhyen gnyis rta bdun dbang po rgyas pa yis/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa'i phung po rang sar dengs/ /bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal bde chen steng du gsungs pa/ bu kun/ chos la lag len zhig dgos pa yin/ de la gzhi ma dam tshig dang sdom pa ma nyams pa'i sgo nas rtogs ldan gyi bla ma zhig la gsol ba dung dung pa 'debs shing snang ba gang shar gyi steng du 'dzin med du 'jog pa 'di sgom ma skyes pa skyed byed kyang yin/ skyes nas bogs 'don pa yang 'di las zab pa med de/ chos rje ras pa'i khyad chos ro snyoms skor drug kyang phyag rgya chen po skyong bar byed pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ lag len 'di las zab pa med/ ro snyoms 'di mdo sngags thams cad kyi nying khu yin/ de la dang po rnam rtog lam du 'khyer ba ltas ngan g.yang du lon pa'i gdams ngag la/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rnam par rtog pa las byung ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /zhes pas/ rtog pa rang ga mar shor ba gnyen pos ma spangs par gdams ngag gis lam du byas tsa na/ yang de nyid las/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rtog med gsal/ /zhes gsungs pa de yong ste/ rtog pa de ma spangs gnas su dag nas nyams len chos skur krong 'char ba yin gsungs/ des na nyon mongs dang rnam rtog 'di rnams lung ma bstan yin/ 'di thabs kyis zin na sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro /rang ga mar spyad na 'khor ba'i rgyu mi dge ba skyed de/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mi dge ba thabs kyis ma zin na sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro mi srid gsungs/ de la rnam rtog lam 'khyer gyi gdams ngag gi thabs rang gang yin byas na/

ro snyoms nas/ dang po rnam rtog ngos bzung*/ bar du bdag 'dzin blos gtong*/ mtha' ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal zhes pas/ rnam rtog ngos bzung na slob dpon gyis da lta nga la gdams ngag cig bshad na dga' ste/ khrid cig btab na dga' ste snyam pa cig yong ba de yin te/ da sgom na 'di ltar gyis/ ma nam mkha' ma nus tshad bgrangs shing sems ji ltar 'dug pa ltar ma bcos par bzhag na rdza lan dgu tshos te gdams ngag thob thob po zhig 'dod pa 'di kha tshe 'di'i rnam rtog yin/ da rtog pa de ngos tshir bzung nas de'i rjes su yang ma 'brang spong yang mi spong bar sems bcas bcos med par gang shar gyi thog tu lhan gyis 'jog pa de la nyams len gyi ngo ti byas te ji ltar 'dug pa de kha ltar sa le ye re shig ge bzhag pas rtog pa de nyid spang mi dgos gnyen po ye shes logs nas btsal mi dgos par gang shar de spang blang dang bral nas nyams len du lhang gis 'char ba de la ci zer byas na/ rnam rtog phra rags thams cad ma spangs gnas su dag pas na rnam rtog chos skur shar ba zhes bya/ rnam rtog chos skur shar bas rnam rtog lam 'khyer mngon du gyur pa bya ba yin te de kha la rje gling gis/ ma bcos so mar bzhag na rtogs pa 'char/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsgoms na yongs kyang 'char/ /dmigs gtad mtshan ma thams cad yongs spongs la/ / rtag tu mnyam par zhog cig rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes gsungs/ nam mkha' rin po che'i mdo las/ ji ltar mar la mar bzhag gam/ /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag ltar// rang gi rig pa'i ye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs/ bram ze chen pos kyang*/ gnyug ma'i yid ni gcig tu sdod dang rnal 'byor pa/ /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du shes par byos/

/zhes gsungs pas/ nyams len de rtog pa gcig gi steng du shes tsa na 'dam bu gcig khog pa stong tsa na 'dam bu thams cad khog stong bya ba yin pas/ rtog pa thams cad 'di yis lam du khyer ba yin mod/ sgom mtho ru song nas rtog pa phra mo thams cad chos skur 'char ba'i dus na yang nyams bzang po de mi rtag gi dogs pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/ ngan dus su des ma chog gi dogs pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/ gnyid mthug po'i g.yeng bas 'byams pa'i dus su rang sa na 'dzin pa med kyang ngos ma zin pas 'di rnams lam du 'gro'am mi 'gro'am snyam pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/ dran pa rgyun chags su skyes pa'i dus su 'di lam du 'gro yi snyam pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/ 'di yang stong zhen yin snyam pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/ cha la ba rgan dang ma bral na them pa la gtsang ba'i dus mi 'ong bas myong 'dod cig ma dag gi bar la rtog pa thabs mi chag ste de kha phyag rgya chen po'i longs spyod yin pas/ sngar gyi gdams ngag gnad des lam du 'khyer ba yin/ de bzhin du rgod 'gyod bying rmugs pa la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi sgrib pa lnga yang 'dis lam du 'khyer ba yin gsungs nas bying rgod kyi 'bru snon kyang mdzad do/ /sgom ngo mthong re snga mor byung yang skyed nus kyang mi 'ongs pa de thams cad dran pa kho rang shugs la sad cing sgom yad yud byung ba ma gtogs nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa ci tsam skyes kyang nyams len du 'dag mi nus/ rtog pa lam 'khyer gyi gnad 'di med par chos sku yin/ ye shes yin snyam pa'i go yul res khengs te dus re la rgyas btab kyin 'jog par 'dug ste/ las yog che bas phan rgyu med/ sgom chen phal che ba rnam rtog rgya 'byams kyi gseb tu sgom mun nag gi glog lta bu yad yud kam kem re 'byung ba ma gtogs thams cad go yul du shor nas med/ sgom pa go cha che ba kun kyang gnas lugs kyi steng du sdod mi tshugs par mtha' mar bsnyen pa re la kha lhan te 'gro yin 'dug/

rje 'bri khung pas/ zab chos rgya che ba re gsungs pa'i rjes la phyag g.yas pa'i mthe bong phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du btsugs nas/ bu kun hril gyi dril na 'di las med de gang zhe na/ dran pa/ dran pa/ dran pa mkhas na sgom pa mkhas gsungs/ chos rje ras pa'i zhal nas/ dran pas ma zin go yul yin/ /sangs rgyas lam du 'gro mi srid gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ dbang phyug lus gtogs dran pa bde gshegs kyis/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam 'di nye bar bstan/ /de la sgrims nas mngon par bsrung bgyi ste/ /dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas blo skyed med tshad sgom skyong ma shes pas lan pa yin/ sgom skyong ba la dran pas 'dzin pa las zab pa med/ de la gnad 'di med na sgom dma' dus su dran pa rang gis 'ching bar 'dug /rnam rtog lam 'khyer gyi gnad 'di yod pa bu chung lo gsum lon pa'i kha na yang yod/ nyams su len sgom chen pa rgad po chos kyang mi shes par 'dug /chos pa g.yer por byed pa kun gyis kyang 'di'i mtshang ma rnyed par/ ma bcos par glod la zhog bya ba de gang na yang 'dug zer nas nyams su len rin mi chog pa'i chos su byas nas kha ton la sogs byed par 'dug gsungs// // ༈ gnyis pa nyon mongs pa lam du 'khyer ba dug bdud rtsir sgyur ba'i gdams ngag kyang*/ sngar gyi de kha 'dun pa sgyur ba las med de/ he badzra las/ ji ltar rlung gis zin pa la/ /mon sran rde'u'i bza' ba sbyin/ /bzlog pa'i sman ni sngags pa las/ /rlung gis rlung la snun par byed/ /rnam rtog las ni rnam rtog dang*/ /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa 'dag /ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa/ /chu gzhan gyis ni dbyung bar bya/ /ji ltar me yis tshig pa yi/ /me nyid la ni bdug par bya/ / de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig pa/ /'dod chags nyid kyis dbyung bar bya/ / skye bo mi bzad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching gyur pa/

/thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/ chags pas chags pa dag gyur te/ /zhe sdang nyid kyis zhe sdang sbyang*/ / gti mug nyid kyis gti mug sbyang*/ /nga rgyal chen pos nga rgyal sbyang*/ /phrag dog gis ni phrag dog sbyang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs thams cad sbyong*/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems nyon mongs pa 'dod chags skyes pa'i dus su tha mal pa ltar rjes su yang mi 'brang*/ theg pa 'og ma pa ltar spong yang mi spong*/ chos sku yin ye shes yin snyam pa'i blos byas kyi nges shes kyang mi byed par rang thog tu glod la 'dzin med bcas bcos med par 'jog pa yin te 'dod chags su lam me ba de kha la nyams len gyi ngo ti byas nas de las gzhan pa'i rtog pas dben par byas nas gsal ye re bsgom pa yin/ der 'dod chags kyi 'dzin pa de ma spangs gnas su dag nas bde stong so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su krongs 'char te rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi thugs dgongs mngon du byas pa yin te/ de skad du yang*/ skyes bu 'dod chags can rnams kyang*/ /'dod chags kyis ni thul bar 'gyur/ /bya ba yang 'dod chags med pa'am/ chung du 'gro ba ma yin te/ bde mchog ra li las/ 'dod chags la brten nas bde ba'i yul drug gi dgra rnams bcom nas gnyis med thob par 'gyur zhes pas/ 'dod chags la brten nas de dag grol ba thob pa la dgongs pa yin/ 'dod chags che ba'i gang zag de la 'dod chags nyid lam du byas nas bsgoms na gzhan gang bas kyang lam chod che ba yin/ de la nga'i gdams ngag 'di'i gnad yod na su 'dod chags che ba 'tshengs pa yin te/ dper na rta mgyogs po la skyes bu 'jur na lam chod rtsol med du che ba ltar/ nyon mongs pa drag po gdams pa'i gnad kyis zin na nyon mongs pa de nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi sar skyel ba yin/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mis/

byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni res 'ga' nyon mongs pa spong bar yang byed/ res 'ga' nyon mongs pa skyed par yang byed de dper na byi las byi ba la byed pa bzhin no zhes gsungs pas/ ched du 'dod chags mngon du byas shing ro snyoms pa dang*/ sngar bzhin phyag rgya chen po nyams su blangs pas 'dod chags chos skur shar te chags pa rtsad nas chod pas der 'dod chags gcig pu la nyon mongs pa lnga char tshang ste/ de gcig pu'i steng nas nyon mongs pa thams cad thag chod nas yid la med par grub thob tu 'gro ba la tshegs med/ de ltar 'dod chags phyag rgya chen po'i dbang du 'dus tsa na/ 'dod chags las grub pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dbang du 'du/ thabs lam gyi yon tan thams cad kyang shugs la 'ong gsungs/ nyams len gyi gnad 'di yod na las rgya mi dgos/ ye shes kyi rtogs pas ma zin na rlung nus kyi thig le ma shor kyang lam du mi 'gro snyam/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/ rgyun gyi rdo rje 'dzin sogs thams cad sbyong*/ /zhes pa yang*/ zhe sdang thabs kyis zin nas chos skur shar na rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du 'dod chags chos skur shar na padma 'dzin pa/ nga rgyal chos skur shar na rin chen 'dzin pa/ phrag dog chos skur shar na ral gri'am rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin pa/ gti mug chos skur shar na 'khor lo 'dzin par 'ong ste/ rgyal ba rigs lnga po 'di'i thugs kyi dgongs pa phyag mtshan lngas mtshon te/ nyon mongs pa lnga po chos skur shar na rgyal ba rigs lnga dang thugs kyi dgongs pa gcig tu gyur par gsungs/ nyon mongs pa lam du 'khyer ba'i go ba rang gang yin na/ nyon mongs pa'i nus pa choms nas chos sku'i rtsal 'byongs shing bkrag 'don te gnyis med kyi rtogs pas nyon mongs pa'i dag byed byas nas dug bdud rtsir sgyur ba yin nam snyam/ spros bral gyi dus su rtog pa phra mo rnams dran pa ma yengs pa ngang gis chos skur 'char te/

chags sdang rags pa rnams la nyon mongs pa lam 'khyer gyi gnad 'di med na phyag rgya chen por cung mi 'char gsungs/ de ltar 'dod chags lam du 'khyer bas bar dor mngal sgo dgag pa la tshegs med de pha ma 'khrig sred byed pa mthong tsa na chos sku'i ngo sprod du 'char/ de ma shar yang sngar goms pa'i gnad kyis yul thog de rang du glod nas 'dzin med tu 'jog pa zhig shugs la 'ong*/ der skad cig gnyis pa la yul ma spangs gnas su dag nas chos skur 'char gsungs/ 'dod chags la rgyas par sbyar nas de bzhin du zhe sdang sogs la yang 'gre gsungs/ zhe sdang gi skabs su mngon spyod sgrub thabs la yang 'di las zab pa med gsungs/ phrag dog la/ sgom ro gcig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa yang phrag dog rna bar sil ma btsugs pa'i zug 'dra ba 'ong srid gsungs/ gti mug la 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i gnad la yang 'di las zab pa med de 'dis rtogs pa'i 'od gsal sbar zin byed pa yin/ gnyid bro thibs se ba'i dus su de nyid ngos tshir gyis bzung nas bcas bcos med par bzhag tsa na gnyid bro ba de nyid ma spangs gnas su dag nas chos skur krongs te 'ong*/ de la rtogs pa'i 'od gsal du 'dod pa yin/ de med pa'i nyams kyi 'od gsal yad yud zin pas phan med gsungs// //༈ gsum pa lha 'dre lam du 'khyer ba bar chad dngos grub tu bsdu ba la yang 'di las zab pa med de/ de yang lho brag mkhar chu lta bu'i gnas gnyan sa zhig tu sdod pa'i dus su nyi ma dgongs na mar 'jigs chum chum yong*/ de'i dus su 'jigs thog tu ngos tshir gyis bzung nas sems bcas bcos mi byed par gang shar gyi thog tu lhan gyis bzhag pas 'jigs snang de rang la bsgom gyi ngo tir byas nas shes pa grung bton la gsal ye re bsgoms pas 'jigs snang de nyid nyams len du krongs kyis 'ong*/ de kha'i rjes la 'jigs snang de med par bag gro 'ur 'gro gsungs/

de nyid la chags zhen med par sngar bzhin nyams su blangs pas rjes la 'jigs snang ci skyes kyang dgag blo mi skye ba yin/ bde ba la sgrub blo mi skye ba yin/ sdug bsngal la spang blo mi skye ba chos nyid yin gsungs/ gsang spyod chod che ba'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ gnas gnyan po 'di rnams su phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel 'dzoms nas phyi rol tu gdon gyi cho 'phrul dang rang rgyud la rigs mi 'dra ba'i nyon mongs pa du ma lus thog tu na tsha'i bar chad du 'ong*/ yang na bogs thon pa las btang snyoms su mi las nges pa yin/ de yang klu gdon drag po gnas pa'i sa der klu'i cho 'phrul ci yang 'ong ste klu dang sa bdag rnams rang gi gti mug gi gzugs brnyan phyir shar ba yin pas nang du gnyid mig dang nge ba la 'gro ba 'ong*/ sngar dus tshod cig la nga la 'gro yin 'gro yin la gnyid yor yor 'gro ba byung*/ sa gzhi bar snang thams cad sbrul gyis khrigs gang ba'i snang ba byung tsa na shig nad brgyab nas do shi do chad byung*/ shig nad 'di 'og gdon du 'dug /de'i dus su lus phyed tshal 'phrigs pa la dran tshor med pa byung*/ phyis ti se nas log nas sangs rgyas dbon gyi spyan sngar zhus pas/ khong gis brtag pa mkhyen nas nga'i mig la gzigs te/ phaṭa tshi re bu klus de'u khyer 'dug gsungs/ de nas lha khab tu lo hril bu gsum du ma drag

/de nas tsa ri'i gnas byin rlabs can de ru drag pa yin/ de lta bu'i lus thog tu mdze la sogs pa rkyen drag po mang po byung ste phyag rgya chen po'i ngang 'ba' zhig tu bzhag nas phan du re la sogs pa ma byas par glod nas bzhag pas sos pa yin/ de'i dus su gdon drag po'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang sngar gyi gdams ngag gis nyams su blang ngo*/ /zlog sgom dang spros bcas 'di rnams kyang rgyud thog tu ro ma snyoms pa'i tsab tsub yin pa las ro snyoms kyi dgongs pa rang cung min/ cho 'phrul dang gdug rtsub ji ltar tshe yin 'tshengs pa yin/ de kha 'dod nas gnyan sar bsnyegs pa yin pas phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du sngar bzhin bsgom/ mdor na 'jigs nas phyir 'thon mi nus snyam byed pa de la gnyen po zlog sgom dang spros bcas la sogs bya'am snyam pa'i rtog pa thams cad kyi thog tu sngar bzhin phyag rgya chen po bskyangs pas rtog pa de chos skur 'char ba dang gdon dbang du 'dus pa gnyis srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin 'ong ba yin/ der phyi'i rten 'brel klu de chos skyong du 'dus tsa na nang du gti mug 'od gsal du 'char ba dang lus thog gi nad drag pa dus gcig tu 'ong*/ dgon pa la sogs gnas phal par phyi'i rten 'brel ma tshang bas nang du las dang nyon mongs pa lhong mi 'ongs/ der phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len du ro snyoms rgyu mi 'ongs pas dgon pa la sogs par lo gsum bzhi dam bcas nas bsgoms pa bas gnyan sar zhag gsum bzhi dam bcas nas bsgoms na bogs che bar gsungs/ chos rje ras pa'i gdams ngag 'dis nang gi las dang nyon mongs pa bag la nyal thams cad phyi dbang po'i mngon sum du thed la bton nas 'ong ba'i gdams ngag yin/ 'tshang mi rgya ba'i dbang med/ nang du nyon mongs pa'i rigs gang skyes pa de ngos bzung nas de'i rigs 'dre gdon gang yod sar phyin nas gsang spyod byed pa yin/

lha 'dre drag po dang thug pa byung na yang de gnas pa'i sar phyin la kho'i rigs 'dra'i nyon mongs pa de phyag rgya chen pos nyams su blangs pas gdon thul nas chos skyong du 'ong*/ nang du nyon mongs pa mda' dug can khong du chud pa 'dra ba de phyi'i lha 'dre'i gzugs su dngos su ston nas de nyid phyag rgya chen pos rang gar khyer ba'i gdams ngag zab mo 'di 'dra bu khyod kyis sgrub pa zhig ma byung na re phangs gsungs// //༈ don bzhi pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal lam du 'khyer ba'i gdams ngag la/ yul sdug bsngal ba mthong tsa na/ a tsa ma 'di 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal rgyud thog tu byung na bzod ri shi snyam nas yul de la snying rje mi skye bar rang re la 'gos kyi dogs nas dge sbyor la blo hril gyis 'gro ba byung na nyan rang gi lam yin pas de ngos bzung la rtog pa de'i steng du bcas bcos med par sngar bzhin bzhag pas nyams len du ro snyoms pa dang yul des gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la byams snying rje bsgom zhing ro snyoms pa dang dge sbyor bdun pa ltar smon lam gdab/ yul sdug bsngal ba mthong ba dang snying rje tshad bzung med pa rang gzhan brje nus pa'i snying rje'i stobs 'dug na byang chub sems dpa'i thugs snang yin pas rtog pa de ngos bzung la sngar bzhin ro snyoms ste phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos par mdangs snying rjer lam me ba'i ngang las zung 'jug tu smon lam gdab/ gzhan yang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsam zhing de la snying rje skyes pa dang sngar bzhin ro mnyam zhing smon lam gdab/ der phyag rgya chen pos rgyas thebs na byams pa bsgoms tshad gnyug ma byams chen/ snying rje bsgoms tshad dmigs med snying rje/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed tshad don dam pa'i sems skyed/ dge ba gang byas kyang zag pa med pa'i dge bar 'gyur bas/ mdo na mar/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sa mtshams 'khor gsum du rtog mi rtog tu bzung nas yod/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur pas na/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba brtan par bzung*/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyag rgya chen pos ma zin tshad thams cad 'jig rten pa'i lam yin te/ smon lam dang byams pa la sogs pa gang bsgoms kyang brgyud pa'i rgyu'am gnas skabs su tshangs pa'i gnas la sogs pa ma gtogs pa rang gzhan gnyis ka gol bar mi nus te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdo las/ bdag dang sems can dang snying rje gsum du dmigs pa de ni snying rje chung ngu yin no/ / bdag ma mthong sems can ma mthong snying rje ma mthong bar thams cad mnyam pa nyid du shes pa de ni snying rje chen po yin no zhes gsungs so// //༈ don lnga pa na tsha lam du 'khyer ba 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag la/ rlung mkhris bad kan nam/ sa gdon la sogs pa'i gcong nad rnying pa'am/ mdor na nad rigs ci byung yang nyams len 'di las med/ de la dang po rnam rtog ngos bzung*/ bar du bdag 'dzin blos gtong*/ mtha' ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal zhes pas/ nad ngos 'dzin pa la ro snyoms nas mang du gsungs 'dug ste/ dbang po rab 'bring thams cad la phan par dgongs nas gsungs pa yin/ nged rang gi lugs kyis nad kho rang rgyu ci yis skyed mod/ rkyen cis bslad mod/ 'bras bu nad rigs gang smin mod/ mdor na lus thog tu na zug gam bde ba gang 'dug pa de dgag sgrub dang chags sdang gi ngor ma shor ba sgom gyi ngo tir ngos 'dzin pa de la dang po rnam rtog ngos 'dzin pa zer ba yin/ de yang dpal bi rū pa'i lam 'bras nas/ nyams sems la 'char/ ngag sngags la 'char/ gar lus la 'char bya ba yin pas/ nad zug la sems 'dzin pa de'i stobs kyi hu yu la sogs pa ngag tu 'don/

lus po dang ngo gdong nag po la sogs pa 'ong bar gsungs/ rje ko brag pa'i lam 'bras kyang nga'i lag tu byung nas dar la gtums yod gsungs/ bar du bdag 'dzin blos btang bya ba de nyams len gyi mthil yin te de yang dge bshes bka' gdams pa kun gyi gsungs pa bzhin sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'khor ba skyur ba'i mkhan po bdag 'dzin 'dir 'dug /na ba 'di yang bdag 'dzin 'dis lan 'dug pas/ da bdag 'dzin blos btang snyam nas zhe gnag skyed kyang blos gtong mkhan rang bdag 'dzin yin pas spangs kyis spong ba mi 'ongs gsungs/ bzhad cing 'o na ji ltar yin byas na bdag 'dzin dang na zug gnyis tha dad med pas zug che bdo ba'i dus na sngar bzhin zug thog de nyid du sems bcas bcos med par lhan gyis glod nas bzhag /zug de nyid la nyams len gyi ngo tir byas nas ma yengs par bsgoms pas na zug gam bdag tu 'dzin pa de spang mi dgos par nyams len phyag rgya chen por krong gis 'ong*/ der dug sman du gyur pa ltar na zug gam bdag 'dzin rang chos skur shar tsa na bdag tu 'dzin pa btsal yang mi rnyed pas bdag 'dzin blos btang gsha' ma zhig de la 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ mtha' ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal bya ba ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas nad drag tu re ba dang*/ ma drag gi dogs pa dang*/ sman dpyad la sogs ci bya'am mno ba dang*/ zlog sgom la sogs pa ci bya ba'am mno ba la sogs pa thams cad nad thog tu ro ma snyoms pa'i tsab tsub ste nad thog tu sdod ma zug pa yin pas gang shar de nyid ngos bzung nas mi spong bar sngar bzhin lta thog tu bskyur nas ro snyoms pa yin/ yang*/ de 'dra'i snyoms 'jug pa dang nga 'dra ba gcig 'ong ba da dung rkyen mi theg par 'dug pa snyam du rang la yi chad pa 'ongs pas de la'ang sngar bzhin ro mnyam mo/ /yang pho gzer lta bu'i zug tsha khang khang pa la sems ma bcos par bzhag tsa na zug gzer gyi tshor ba mi 'gag cing gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa gtan med par gcig chog tu lhang 'gro la de tsa na zug kyang tsha khang pa lus thog tu 'ong*/

rkyen la bsre 'dod kyi rtog pa de mnyam par bzhag kyang 'jog byed kyi rtog pa de nyid rang sar dag cing 'gro ba la sogs pa ban bun bag re rig thog tu 'ong ba yang lag pa'i rtse la yod pa yin/ de byung dus su da rung ro mi snyoms par bdag 'dzin 'jug gin 'dug snyam pa'i glo 'dun 'ong ste/ phyag rgya chen po la gnyis med dang rtog med du grub pa med gnyis snang gi rtog pa bkag pa med de/ slob dpon hūṃ ka ras/ kun yin gang yang ma yin pa'i/ /rig pa khyab gdal ngo bo nyid/ /rang snang rang gsal bde chen po/ /ma lus kun gyi dngos gzhir gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ blo 'dun gyi sel gang byung yang sngar gyi ro snyoms kyi gnad des 'bur 'joms su nyams su len pa yin/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas ya thag chad pa gcig min pa mi drag mi srid/ de'i rgyu mtshan gegs sel nas rgyu 'chos pa/ rkyen bsal ba/ 'bras bu gzhom pa dang gsum dgos pa yin te de yang nad thams cad kyi rgyu ma rig pas gzhi byas pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa yin pas de'i dag byed la phyag rgya chen po las zab pa med de/ phyogs bcu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ gal te 'gyod tshangs byed 'dod na/ / drang por 'dug la yang dag ltos/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /de ni 'gyod tshangs mchog yin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ bskal ba stong du bsags pa'i mun nag kyang*/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer gcig gis 'joms par byed/ /de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal skad cig gis/ /bskal bar bsags pa'i ma rig sdig sgrib bsreg /ces gsungs/ rkyen bsal ba la/ dang po nad thams cad rlung log tu 'byung bas phyag rgya chen pos rlung thams cad dwangs nas 'byung bzhi cha snyoms 'gro /'bri khung pa'i dmigs pa'i gnad thams cad kyang rlung thur du 'bebs par 'dug ste rlung log thams cad phyag rgya chen po min pas mi drag par 'jug /thur du bsring ba'i dmigs pa 'di rnams kyang sems ma zin na mi phan/

sems zin na de rang gi rlung gnad du tshud 'gro bar 'dug /des na rnam par rtog pa phyag rgya chen po'i khog tu bskyur tsa na rlung dang rnam rtog gnad gcig pas rlung log pa dang log mkhan gang yang mi 'ongs pa yin gsungs/ 'bras bu 'joms pa la/ na ba nyid phyag rgya chen por shar tsa na nad zug sdug ge ro med khung med du bcom nas dgag sgrub kyi rtog pa thams cad rtsa ba nas grol 'gro ba yin/ des ma song na sngar gyi na tsha des las ngan mi 'dzad de de la chags sdang skyes pas yang las ngan bsags pas srid pa phyi ma'i rgyur song nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la zad pa mi 'ongs pa yin/ mtho dman chags sdang sna tshogs su 'char ba bag la nyal du yod pa rnams sgom ro gcig gi dus su lhong ba yin/ rje 'bri gung pa'i zhal nas/ lhong nas dag par ma shes na/ /phyi la btsal na dag par dka'/ /gsungs/ kho bos kyang mi tshe na ba la bskyal te dgag sgrub kyi chags sdang ma byas par na tsha'i thog nas thar pa'i lam bgrod sgrib pa'i thog thag bcad pa yin/ khong rnams kyis dbang med rim gro byas tsa na yang*/ ngas bla ma dkon mchog thugs mi chad par zhu'o bdag la ni rim gro la ltos pa spu tsam yang med do byas gsungs/ nad drag nas de la rlom sems 'jug gin 'dug na/ de sman ma zhu ba dug tu song ba dang 'dra bas de ro mnyam par byed pa gal che/ de ma yin pa yang na ba'i dus su na tsha lam 'khyer gyi gnad kyis dar cig zug chag nas da rang drag par 'dug zug langs kyang bsgoms pas chog par 'dug snyam pa 'byung*/ de nas bag tsam nar byung ba dang da rung na ru 'ong bar 'dug bsgom dgos sam nas ro snyoms la zlog sngags rnon po bzhin nad de'i gnyen por shor dogs yod pas rtog pa skye ba mi 'gegs/ skyes dus su ro mnyam pa gal che/ 'di 'byung ring po ma yin gsungs/ spyir ro snyoms kyi gnad che shos rang gong du 'dun pa gtong ba 'di yin gsungs/

de yang rkyen drag po dang thug na dga' ste/ de dus lta thog tu ro snyoms snyam pa byas pa rkyen dang phrad pa dang chig chod hril gyis 'gro /dper na jag pa nyung ngus tshong pa mang po 'joms pa dang 'dra ste gcig 'ong du re gcig byung gis dogs pas 'dun pa'i khyad par zhugs pa yin gsungs so// //༈ don drug pa 'chi ba lam du 'khyer ba ma bu ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag bya ba de ro snyoms thams cad la 'gro ba yin/ don la ma shi'i bar du rgyun du bsgoms pas 'chi ba'i dus su goms pa'i shugs kyis phyag rgya chen po la shugs kyis 'gro /der 'od gsal ma bu 'dres nas rtog pa'i rang gzugs chos skur 'tshang rgya ba yin/ chos sku'i nus pa'am rtsal du bar do'i dang por longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i skur snang nas dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi don byed/ skye ba len par 'dod pa'i dod por sprul pa'i skus nyan rang dang so so skye bo rnams la gang la gang 'dul ba'i skur bstan nas 'dul ba yin/ de yang rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal zhes pa'am chos nyid kyi ma zhes pa gzhan du gcig kyang med pa'i bar do dang po kho nar 'ong ba gcig min/ chos nyid kyi ma zhes kyang bya yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma zhes kyang bya ste dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ sems can la rang chas su yod pa de tshogs drug gi snang bar gsal bas rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal zhes bya ste ming ji ltar btags kyang tshogs drug gi snang ba ma bcos pa 'di yin te slob dpon hūṃ ka ras kyang*/ gang yang ma 'gags ci yang gsal/ /rang byung ye shes ngo bor 'dug /mtha' rnams thams cad ma spangs bral/ /lhun grub bde chen rang gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs par rtogs/ /zhes gsungs/ rtog pa'i 'od gsal lam rig pa'i ye shes bya ba yang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis gshis kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa 'di kha la zer ba yin/

rtogs pa de rtog pa lam 'khyer gyi gnad kyis bogs 'don cing nyams su blangs pas bar do dang por shes pa'i smin dus nges pa can yin pas 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag gi kha bsgyur tsa na chos sku thob pa yin/ de min pa'i 'chi ba'i dus su dkar lam pa 'byung*/ dmar lam pa byung*/ de ltar 'od gsal 'byung ngo snyam du ra bgrang ba bzhin byas kyang 'od gsal mi zin/ de rnam rtog yin/ rnam rtog ma rig pa yin/ ma rig pa dang 'od gsal gnyis dngos 'gal yin mod gsungs/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i gnad la da lta rtog pa lam 'khyer gyi gnad kyis snang ba 'di ma bcos par skyong ba las zab pa med pas ro snyoms skor drug zer zhing g.yer che ba yin mod/ ro snyoms kyi gnad 'di sngon slob dpon hūṃ ka ras kyang gsungs 'dug ste ji ltar zer na/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sems 'di ma bcos rang sar bzhag /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs/ /gang mthong gang snang de nyid kyis/ / ngang la mnyam par lhang nge bzhag /gang yang ma 'gags mi 'dzin cing*/ /mnyam nyid rig pa'i gdeng la bzhag /de ltar rtogs shing goms pa yis/ /me yi phung po 'bar ba la/ /yam shing skam po bsnan pa ltar/ /dngos po gang mthong gang snang yang*/ /de nyid ye shes rkyen du 'gyur/ /phyogs gcig kho nar mi bsgom ste/ /

ting 'dzin 'bum phrag du ma la/ /rnal 'byor rig pa'i rtsal sbyong bya/ /rig pa mtha' dbus med pa yi/ /bde chen spyi blugs nyid du 'char/ /nam mkha'i mthongs su mdung bskor bzhin/ /rig pa'i ngang la rang dbang bsgyur/ /de ltar gdeng chen goms pa'i mchog /de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /spyod pa blang dor med par spyad/ /spang ni ci yang mi spangs la/ /ched du gang yang bya rgyu med// spyod lam ma 'gags blang dor bral/ /ma bsgrubs 'bras bu bdag nyid rdzogs/ / ma blangs dngos grub rang la shar/ /ma bgrod lam mchog lhun gyis rdzogs/ / zhes pa la sogs gsungs 'dug ste/ de phyag len la 'debs shes pa de chos rje 'brug pa tsam yin gsungs/ des na spyir rtog pa thams cad/ khyad par byas na 'chi ba sems kyi rnam rtog snying khong grang lhang nge ba 'ong ba de yang lus sems la yang bden rdzun bltas pa'i rtog pa yin par sngar bzhin nyams thog tu blangs pas/ 'chi ba sems kyi rnam rtog ma spangs gnas su dag nas bar do gsum gyi rtog snang yal te/ 'di dang phyi ma gcig tu 'dres bya ba 'ongs pas/ 'di phyi bar do gsum/ skad cig snga phyi/ nyin mo mtshan mo/ phyed gong phyed 'og la sogs pa thams cad sems nyid gnyug ma ma bcos pa'i gsal snang la bya rtog pas brdar btags shing ri mor bris pa yin/ de ltar tshe 'di la nyams len thul tshud par byas nas 'chi ba'i dus su bla ma bzhugs na bsags pa rab yin/ de mi bzhugs na rang gi mched grogs 'gram du bzhag la/ bdag tu bzung ba spu tsam yang med par byas la rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos yin pas gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug pa'am/ yang na me rlung gyen la 'bar ba chos nyid yin pas tsog pu'i 'khrul 'khor bya ste don la 'pho bar 'gro ba yin gsungs/ de la sogs pa gang byed kyang spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la mos gus dung ba zhig byas te de'i ngang la sems bcas bcos med par lhod de bzhag

/de'i dus su yul rkyen ngan pa la gzab la dus tshod chen por song bas nyams len la cag grims 'gro ba las yengs thabs med de 'khor 'das kyi so mtshams yin pas yengs thabs med snyam du bsgrims na dran pa de rang rgyud du shor dogs yod pas/ shes pa 'khyar 'dod pa'am cag grims pa byung dus su de rang phyag rgya chen po rtog pa lam 'khyer gyi gdams ngag gis sngar bzhin nyams su blangs pas zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por lhod shig gis 'gro ba yin/ de'i ngang la dbugs song na rig pa khyod rang 'phongs nas 'gro na yang rgyug /a'u tsi/ rab mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya ba yin/ 'di kho bo'i spar tshod min/ rgyud rnams su rdo rje 'chang gis/ 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed/ /ces bshad/ rje dam pa rgya gar gyis kyang*/ na ba na ba min 'byung ba dwangs snyigs 'byed pa yin/ 'chi ba 'chi ba min rnal 'byor 'tshang chung rgya ba yin bya ba gsungs 'dug /dus gnad skyen pa re la khel na 'tshang rgya ba la ring po med gsungs/ de yang rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa de 'chi kha ma der srid pa mtha' ma'i byang chub sems dpa' yin te/ srid pa mtha' ma la rgyal bu don grub dka' thub las bzhengs nas rdo rje gdan du byang chub kyi shing drung du byon pa'i dus su gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra zhing phra ba gcig las spang rgyu med pa ltar rnal 'byor pa de la yang 'chi rgyu med par shes te nyams myong gi steng du sing nge song ba'i mi rtog pa ngo ma shes phra mo de las spang rgyu med/ gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra mo de bla ma'i mos gus dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug gi rtogs pa des spangs nas 'tshang rgya ba yin/ zung 'jug gi rtogs pa de la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ste/ mgon po byams pas/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/

/rtogs pa mi shigs thob nas ni/ /gnas gzhan 'gyur ba mthar thug yin/ /sgrib pa kun gyi dri ma med/ /ces bshad/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bar na dbugs had had pa 'di las med/ 'bring dus kyi sa/ tha ma skye ba 'dzin pa'i sa bya ba de gzugs sku gnyis kyi thob tshul yin te shugs la 'ong*/ da hril gyis dril na khyed phar phyin pa'i lugs kyis gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyis chos thams cad chos rje ras pa rtog par bzhed pa yin/ rtog pa de'i rang bzhin bsal bzhag med par chos skur ye nas bzhugs pa de ma nges pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ grong khyer gsum gyi sems can rnams/ /bden pa mthong zhing nges ma byas/ /zhes gsungs/ grong khyer gsum po de pha grub pa zhig po'i zhal nas/ snang ba'i grong khyer 'dod khams/ mi snang ba'i grong khyer gzugs med kyi khams/ phyed snang gi grong khyer gzugs khams yin gsungs/ de ltar chos kyi skur ye nas bzhugs pa de rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis zhal mngon sum du blta zhing*/ nges par byed pa la nā ro pa'i rtog pa lam 'khyer zer ba yin/ ro snyoms kyi dgongs pa tig pa rang rgyud la mtho dman gyi rtog pa ci shar tshad chos kyi skur ro snyoms pa la ro snyoms zer ba yin/ rtog pa de nyid ma bcos lam du 'khyer ba la rtog pa lam 'khyer zer ba yin/ de'i gdams ngag la gang shar gyi steng du 'dzin med du 'jog pa las zab pa med/ 'di dang lung rigs kyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa gnyis rtog par gcig ste/ 'di ma bcos par bzhag pa'i skad cig phyi logs su gzhog par bya ba dang 'jog byed kyi rtog pa de nyid rtog med rang gsal du krong gis 'char te 'di rang rig gi rtog pa yin/ gcig la'ang nges shes thag chod gsha' ma de 'ong ste blo yul las ma 'das shes rab can gyis rdzogs chen nam do ha la sogs pa nyan tsa na gzhug tu skyel 'gro yin 'dug pa las/

'phral du rgyud la skyes pa 'dra ba zhig 'ong gi 'dug gsungs so/ /chos kyi rgyal po rgod tshang pa'i zhal gdams ro snyoms phyag rgya chen por sgang dril ba'i gdams pa dpal bde chen steng du gsungs pa athi+-i// // chos sbyin 'dzad med 'jo ba'i gsung par 'di/ /la dwags ngag dbang padma chos rgyal gyis/ /dad gsum bsam sbyor rnam par dag pas bzhengs/ /'dis mtshon zag bcas zag med dge tshogs kyis/ / bstan dang bstan 'dzin bshad sgrub dar zhing rgyas/ /rgyal khams mtha' dbus nad mug 'khrug zhi nas/ / rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i bde skyid dpal 'bar zhing*/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun byang chub myur thob shog / dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /par 'di rgyal gyi shrī ne'u steng du bzhugs// // mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje'i gsung*/ ro snyoms sgang dril/ - PAGE 204 -- PAGE 205 -- PAGE 184 -
